sender.sr: „Regruter“ ili grupa na Telegramu ili WhatsAppu
sender.en: A “recruiter” or group on Telegram or WhatsApp

name.sr: „Laka zarada uz AI projekte i zadatke“: plaćate da biste otključali zaradu
name.en: “Easy money from AI projects and tasks”: you pay to unlock earnings

how.sr: Na društvenim mrežama, Telegramu ili WhatsAppu nude vam laku zaradu od kuće: „AI projekti“, digitalni zadaci, kripto ili paketi članstva, uz bonus za svakog koga dovedete. Na početku isplate male iznose da steknete povjerenje. Zatim traže uplatu da „otključate“ bolje zadatke ili veći nivo, pa naknadu za porez, verifikaciju ili povlačenje novca. Uplaćeni novac se ne vraća.
how.en: On social media, Telegram or WhatsApp you’re offered easy money from home: “AI projects”, digital tasks, crypto or membership packages, with a bonus for everyone you bring in. At first they pay out small amounts to win your trust. Then they ask for a payment to “unlock” better tasks or a higher level, then a fee for tax, verification or withdrawal. The money you paid never comes back.

text.sr: Ponuda lake zarade od kuće preko AI projekata ili zadataka.
text.en: An offer of easy money from home via AI projects or tasks.

text.sr: Prva mala isplata da steknete povjerenje.
text.en: A small first payout to win your trust.

text.sr: Traže uplatu da otključate veći nivo ili zaradu.
text.en: They ask for a payment to unlock a higher level or earnings.

text.sr: Za povlačenje novca traže još naknada.
text.en: To withdraw the money they ask for more fees.

text.sr: Pozdrav! Nasa kompanija trazi saradnike za AI projekat, posao preko telefona 30 min dnevno, zarada 60-150 EUR dnevno. Za aktivaciju VIP naloga potrebna je uplata od 100 USDT, koju vracate vec prvog dana. Javite se ako ste zainteresovani 😊
text.en: Hello! Our company is looking for partners for an AI project, work on your phone 30 min a day, earnings 60-150 EUR a day. Activating a VIP account requires a payment of 100 USDT, which you earn back on day one. Get in touch if you’re interested 😊

sr: zarada od kuće uplata za vip nivo
posao preko telefona uplata u kriptu
honorarni posao od kuće provizija za zadatke
en: work from home pay for vip level

sr: Pravi posao vam ne naplaćuje da biste radili.
Naknada za porez ili povlačenje znači da novac nikad nećete dobiti.
Snimci ekrana i priče drugih „zadovoljnih“ ne dokazuju ništa.
en: A real job doesn’t charge you to work.
A fee for tax or withdrawal means you’ll never get the money.
Screenshots and stories from other “happy” members prove nothing.

sr: Prekinite kontakt i ne uplaćujte više ništa.
Sačuvajte poruke, korisnička imena i potvrde o uplatama.
Prijavite slučaj policiji i odmah se javite banci zbog zaustavljanja transakcija.
en: Stop contact and don’t pay anything more.
Keep the messages, usernames and payment receipts.
Report it to the police and contact your bank at once to stop transactions.

sources.title: Ignorišite ove poruke: Policija upozorava na AI prevare
